_about: PUB5 / PUB5b: Vulkan speed-prediction coefficients fitted on open llama-bench data. The planner (installer/universal/planner.py, DEFAULTS vulkan_efficiency and vulkan_label) carries these numbers and applies the dense and Intel ones; the MoE one is recorded, not applied (see applied_to_planning). tests/test_speed_calibration.py keeps the two equal. Method and sources: docs/SPEED-ESTIMATES.md; rows: reports/pub5/vulkan_rows.csv.
method: efficiency = tg128 tok/s x bytes read per token / peak memory bandwidth

dense.basis: lower quartile of RDNA3 and NVIDIA rows (median 0.72, quartiles 0.67/0.77, n=20)
dense.label: оценка, ±20 %
dense.spread_check: 18 of 20 rows within ±20% of the median

moe.model: qwen3-30b-a3b Q4_K_M, about 2.0 GB active per token
moe.basis: one card (RX 7900 XTX), one source; the same post's dense run on that card is inconsistent, so this is a lower bound until a second source
moe.label: оценка, ±50 %, мало данных
moe.why_not_applied: one card, one source: applying it lowers the default quant of MoE models on AMD (Q4 to Q3), a quality loss on one measurement. Needs a second measurement first.

intel_dense.model: llama-2-7b Q4_0, Intel Arc Vulkan, no flash attention
intel_dense.basis: median of the four Intel Arc rows (0.32-0.59); RDNA3 and NVIDIA are higher
intel_dense.label: оценка, ±50 %, мало данных
